name: SNMP Enumeration
description: Ability to enumerate network devices and services via SNMP. Covers community string guessing and brute-forcing, MIB tree walking, extraction of system information, user accounts, network interfaces, routing tables, and ARP caches from SNMP-enabled devices.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to SNMP enumeration techniques

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands SNMP protocol fundamentals and the security risks of exposed SNMP services
evidence: Can explain SNMP versions (v1, v2c, v3) and their security differences
Understands community strings and their role as authentication
Knows common SNMP ports (161/UDP, 162/UDP) and MIB concepts

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic SNMP enumeration under supervision using standard tools
evidence: Uses snmpwalk, snmp-check, or onesixtyone to query SNMP services
Brute-forces common community strings on discovered SNMP services
Extracts basic system information (sysDescr, sysName, interfaces) under guidance
Documents SNMP findings in engagement notes under review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently performs thorough SNMP enumeration and extracts actionable intelligence
evidence: Systematically walks MIB trees to extract users, routes, ARP tables, and processes
Identifies SNMP write access and its exploitation potential
Correlates SNMP data with other enumeration to map network topology
Uses SNMP data to identify additional attack targets and pivot opportunities

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex SNMP environments; exploits advanced MIBs; mentors others
evidence: Enumerates vendor-specific MIBs for specialized device intelligence
Exploits SNMPv3 weaknesses and misconfigured authentication
Develops automated SNMP enumeration workflows for large network scans
Mentors junior staff on SNMP enumeration and its role in infrastructure assessment

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines SNMP enumeration methodology; deep protocol expertise; trains teams
evidence: Authored the lab's SNMP enumeration standard methodology
Deep understanding of SNMP protocol internals across all versions
Develops custom SNMP enumeration tools or MIB analysis utilities
Trains teams on SNMP-based network intelligence gathering

assessment_methods.description: Enumerate a lab network with multiple SNMP-enabled devices and extract complete system information, routing data, and network topology intelligence
Review SNMP enumeration results from recent infrastructure assessments for completeness
